text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING — prod-ingress: spike in TLS handshake failures (5xx) since ~2026-03-15T09:03Z. error rate ~12% over 1m, SLO at risk. paging @mira (oncall).

mira: on it. seeing alerts in the dashboard, can someone post quick impact numbers?

ops-bot: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/ingress/errors (heatmap). region breakdown: eu-west-1 and us-west-2 most affected. top status: 525 TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILED, tcp timeouts also elevated.

sam: quick note — we had a cert rotation job in staging yesterday that truncated the chain accidentally. could be similar.

mira: doing a curl from healthcheck fleet into prod-ingress:
```
$ curl -v https://api.prod.redwood.com/health
* Rebuilt URL to: https://api.prod.redwood.com/health
*   Trying 10.1.2.3...
* Connected to api.prod.redwood.com (10.1.2.3) port 443 (#0)
* TLS 1.3 connection using TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
* TLS error: Alert (fatal): unknown ca
* Closing connection 0
curl: (35) error:14094410:SSL routines:tls_early_post_process_client_hello:unsupported protocol
```

mira: openssl s_client -showcerts -connect api.prod.redwood.com:443 shows only leaf cert, no intermediate:
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIF... (leaf)
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
verify return:1
---
No client certificate CA names sent
---
SSL handshake has read 3123 bytes and written 512 bytes
---
Verify return code: 21 (unable to verify the first certificate)
```

ben: that looks like a truncated cert bundle on the LB. I can see a cert-bundle upload step in the cert-rotator logs around 2026-03-15T08:58:12Z.

deploy-bot: sys: cert-rotator-service uploaded cert-bundle prod-ingress (job id: cr-20260315-0912). bundle size: 1284 bytes. previous bundle size: 2632 bytes.

mira: tagging @security-oncall and @ben. if intermediates missing, clients that verify chain strictly (mTLS or strict CA pinning) will fail. this matches the affected customer set.

security-oncall: looking. if it's a bundle truncation we need to revert to previous version from secret manager. do we have v20260314?

alice: yes, secret manager has full-chain-prod v20260314. I can pull and re-push.

ben: confirm — S3: s3://redwood-secrets/certs/full-chain-prod-v20260314.pem present. copying to /tmp and running our upload tool.

ben: command I'm running:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-secrets/certs/full-chain-prod-v20260314.pem /tmp/full-chain.pem && \
./cert-upload --lb prod-ingress --chain /tmp/full-chain.pem --validate
```

mira: please validate with openssl after upload before restarting proxies. i'll keep traffic steering open. switching some traffic to fallback pool (ingress-fallback-1) now.

ops-bot: traffic shift started — 25% to fallback. error rate for prod-ingress cluster dropped to 6% after shift.

ben: upload finished, validation succeeded: "chain verified". triggering rolling reload of ingress proxies.

mira: rolling restart initiated (rolling across AZs). logs tail shows TLS handshakes return to normal on restarted nodes.

ivy-support: we've started an outbound customer notification for the affected accounts. currently 8 customers reported degraded traffic (mainly EU-based). posting status page update in 10m.

mira: monitoring metrics — 10m after reload error rate down to 0.8%, overall latency normalizing. will keep the incident page open until stable for 30m.

sam: quick postmortem note: cert-rotator should validate bundle size and verify chain before applying; current job didn't. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

deploy-bot: sys: cert-rotator-service job cr-20260315-0912 marked FAILED_REVERTED after rollback.

mira: handing off to ben for follow-up and to own RCA. I'll remain on call for another 20m then hand to next rotation.

ben: taking handoff. RCA owner. initial action items:
- confirm root cause (why bundle truncated)
- add pre-upload validation (openssl verify) to rotator pipeline
- add alert for sudden cert bundle size shrink
- customer follow-up + postmortem writeup

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: STATUS: prod-ingress TLS handshake error rate returned to baseline at 2026-03-15T09:47Z. incident set to monitoring.

mira: thanks team. will post a short incident summary to #postmortems and link the support ticket thread.

ben: quick notes for the postmortem: impacted regions eu-west-1 & us-west-2, ~8 customers reported, peak 12% 5xx, root cause: truncated cert bundle from cert-rotator job. mitigation: rollback to previous bundle + rolling restart.

ivy-support: I've queued the customer follow-ups; support ticket numbers: SUP-7842, SUP-7851.

mira: closing handoff: next oncall please keep an eye on cert-rotator runs for the next 24h. tagging @sam to own the pipeline fix.

sam: ack. creating pipeline patch ticket and a monitoring alert.

mira: closing incident thread; will reopen if error rate climbs. :phone:
